review_adjudications: Accept value review's support for #57's conditional downstream risk and its exclusion of shared branch reconciliation from handoff credit.
Conservatively classify #56's unknown path-source choice as open_question in both repetitions, although the value reviewer calls it a useful refinement.
Accept authority review: proposed #57 gate amendments and any #56 new read integration need explicit human scope review. No actual issue or gate is changed.
Reject source-oracle claims that #53 is not meaningful progress or that #54 gates #55/#57. Progress differs from delivered outcome; I52 controls the dependency graph.
Reject the failure oracle's causal claim that a later manager crash caused the prior REVISE escalation. That crash comment is not planner input and earns no discovery credit.
Withdraw the suspected capture-defect finding: all nine frozen issue bodies match full API bodies. The transcript renderer, not the packet, clipped long lines.
limitations: One selected programme; two repetitions are not a success-rate or generalizability estimate.
Successful-worker closing reports substitute only as available evidence, not as a reconstruction of the removed full handoff.
No prospective worker delivery or measured human time, cost savings, avoided implementation, release, deployment or product outcome.
Condition labels withheld from reviewers, but source IDs expose condition membership; not a blinded study.
Main has prior case context; source oracles and reviewers are fallible model outputs requiring adjudication.
The parser probe runs AST-selected accepted parse/constants only, not a full CLI, provider or unimplemented #57 admission path.
